catalog.name: tokyo-fix-gotobi-prefix-drift

catalog.mechanism: Japanese importers settle USD invoices on gotobi days (calendar days 5/10/15/20/25/EOM, rolled forward on holidays); fix-executing banks must fill corporate USD-buy orders at the 9:55 fix and pre-hedge from Tokyo open, creating systematic USDJPY appreciation into the fix (Ito-Yamada 2017 documented anomaly).
catalog.counterparty: Japanese corporate importers forced to buy USD for invoice settlement at fix price regardless of level; fix banks pre-hedging their guaranteed-fill obligation
catalog.data: data/cache/massive/USD_JPY_5m_2014_2026.parquet (in-repo, 12y); gotobi calendar derived from JP holiday list (jpholiday pip, offline-computable)
catalog.horizon: entry prior NY close 21:00 UTC or Tokyo open 00:00 UTC, measured at fix 00:55 UTC and forward +1h/+4h/+8h; max hold ~9h
catalog.headroom_est: Honest: documented pre-fix mean drift 2-6p = 1-3x vs 2.14p RT; MFE p50 over overnight-to-fix window ~10-15p = 5-7x. Below 10x bar on the pure window — only the extended-hold variant with month-start/gotobi-overlap conditioning plausibly reaches ~10x. Fails strict entry gate unless MFE-based headroom accepted.

catalog.name: fx-volbeta-premium-xs
catalog.modality: cross-sectional price/vol (daily, 12y, price-only inputs)
catalog.mechanism: Menkhoff et al. (2012): currencies whose returns co-move positively with global FX volatility innovations are stress hedges — risk-averse and leveraged investors overpay for them, so they carry a negative premium; high-vol-beta currencies get force-BOUGHT in stress by carry unwinders and margin-called books. Estimand: cross-sectional sort on trailing beta of each pair's daily return to global FX realized-vol innovations predicts forward 4w return (low-beta > high-beta).
catalog.counterparty: Leveraged carry books and VaR-constrained funds forced to buy vol-hedge currencies in stress
catalog.data: Entirely in-repo: 7 USD pairs 1d 12y. Global FX vol factor = cross-pair mean of daily |return|/realized vol; betas from 126bd rolling regressions. No options data needed (realized-vol innovations, not implieds).
catalog.headroom_est: 4w |move| p50 ~150-250p vs 2.0-4.5p RT => ~40-80x gross; monthly turnover keeps friction accrual low; swap exposure moderate (4w)
catalog.prior_reason: Published, replicated factor (Menkhoff/Sarno/Schmeling/Schrimpf JF 2012) with a real risk-premium mechanism; caveat: vol-beta sorts correlate heavily with carry sorts, so it may be carry wearing a costume — the neutralization guard below is load-bearing given the E20 ban.
catalog.test_design: Signal: 126bd rolling beta to global FX vol innovation series (AR(1) residual of cross-pair realized vol). Monthly sorts; forward 21bd returns. Explore 2014-2021, OOS 2022-2026, LOCK first. Statistics: pooled Spearman IC (non-overlapping 21bd windows, block bootstrap), tercile spread portfolio t-stat, and a MANDATORY carry-neutralization pass: residualize vol-beta on concurrent policy-rate differential; hypothesis only passes if the residualized signal retains IC. FDR across {raw, residualized} x {2 horizons}.
